name: ControlAPI-MCP
description: An MCP server that dynamically converts any OpenAPI or REST API into MCP tools, allowing for real-time server switching and schema reloading. It supports variable substitution for headers and bodies, enabling seamless authentication and interaction with multiple API environments.

rawRecord.description: An MCP server that dynamically converts any OpenAPI or REST API into MCP tools, allowing for real-time server switching and schema reloading. It supports variable substitution for headers and bodies, enabling seamless authentication and interaction with multiple API environments.

BASE_URL.description: The base URL for API requests. Can also be set dynamically using the set_server_config tool.

DEBUG_PORT.description: Port for the browser-based debug UI/monitor.

OPENAPI_URL.description: The URL of the OpenAPI JSON specification. Can also be set dynamically using the set_server_config tool.

SERVER_NICKNAME.description: An optional nickname for identifying the server.

REFRESH_INTERVAL.description: Interval in seconds for automatic schema reloading.
